headline: Brazil’s MGI reports Chat GOV.BR had reached more than 5.6 million users
summary: In a Nov 3, 2026, official update, Brazil’s Ministry of Management and Innovation in Public Services said its Chat GOV.BR public information service, launched in 2026, had reached more than 5.6 million users. The service provides conversational access to public information through simple-language chat, including WhatsApp. The figure is a ministry-reported reach measure; its as-of date, user definition and measurement method are not stated. It does not establish resolution, accuracy, service quality, cost savings or causal impact.
